document.title: Tank-G / Tank-B UltraRig firmware: host <-> pedal control protocol
document.purpose: Clean technical description of the wire protocol observed in the control page (web/tankg.html, web/nam2chip.js). No source, UI text or assets reproduced.
scope_notes: Applies to the alternative firmware (UltraRig, firmware tag 'M5.x'). The factory M-VAVE firmware uses USB-MIDI/USB-audio instead and is NOT covered by this protocol.

Derived by static reading of the page; nothing was executed against a real pedal. Effect table comes from the page's built-in reference catalog (ids 1..39); the pedal itself is the authority and returns its own table with the FXT command (see effects.runtime_discovery).
Field meanings marked '(unverified)' are inferred from how the page parses them.

transport.type: USB CDC-ACM virtual serial port, accessed via the Web Serial API (no SysEx, no MIDI)
transport.usb_product_id: not filtered by the page (any PID with vendor 0x3654; the page stores the last vid/pid it used and prefers it on reconnect)

serial_settings.note: CDC: baud is nominal. Data/stop/parity/flow control left at Web Serial defaults (8N1, none).

transport.os_enumeration: Windows shows 'USB Serial Device (COMn)' using the inbox driver.
detection: Open the port picker with filter {usbVendorId: 0x3654}, or reuse an already-authorised port: prefer the stored vid/pid, else first port with VID 0x3654, else the only authorised port.
Open at 115200 baud (page times out the open after 5 s).
Send PING up to 5 times with a 700 ms reply timeout each; the first line starting with 'PONG' identifies the pedal. No PONG = not this firmware / wrong port.
Hot-plug: listen to serial 'connect'/'disconnect' events to auto-reconnect after a pedal reboot.

alternative_transport.type: Bluetooth LE, Nordic UART Service, same text lines
alternative_transport.note: Writes are split into MTU-3 byte pieces (20 if not negotiated). Unpaired central is read-only: pedal answers 'ERR <cmd> pair'.

host_settings.note: Choices of the PulseDeck host, not part of the pedal protocol. Only the Nordic UART service above is documented for this pedal; the extra names / services are generic fallbacks for UART-over-GATT bridges and have NOT been verified against a pedal.
host_settings.heavy_transfer: Capture (.nam -> A2L1) and IR (.wav) uploads, backups and restores move many KB as hex lines acknowledged one by one: over BLE they are slow (every line is split into 20-byte writes). The host warns and recommends the USB cable.

transport.factory_firmware_detection_note: The page probes Web MIDI (requestMIDIAccess without sysex) only to tell a user the pedal still runs factory firmware; it never sends control data over MIDI.

framing.encoding: ASCII text, one command per line
framing.line_terminator_pedal_to_host: \n, optionally preceded by \r (host strips a trailing \r); blank lines ignored
framing.checksum: none on command lines. CRC32 is used only to verify binary uploads (LDEND / IREND).
framing.tokenisation: space separated; first token = command name (case-sensitive, upper case). Names/strings are plain ASCII without quotes; the pedal replaces non-ASCII bytes with '_'.
framing.flow_control: strictly one command in flight. Host sends a line, then collects reply lines until a terminating line is seen or a timeout expires (default 1500 ms; slow commands 2.5-12 s, see each command). Any line received while nothing is pending is discarded.
framing.reply_termination: Each command has a terminal prefix (e.g. 'FXP', 'PLOAD'). A line starting with 'ERR' also terminates. Multi-line replies end with a sentinel line ('FXT end', 'FXS peak=...', 'PLIST end ...', ...). Older firmware used 'fin' for 'end' and 'pico' for 'peak'; hosts accept both.
framing.error_format: ERR <COMMAND> <reason text>   e.g. 'ERR FXA not enough CPU', 'ERR FXA out of memory', 'ERR FXA bank full', 'ERR FXL too many parallel groups (max 3 per bank)', 'ERR FXA bad argument', 'ERR PLOAD empty or invalid slot', 'ERR SNAP empty slot'

asynchronous_lines.rule: Lines beginning with '@' are unsolicited pushes and are never a command reply.
asynchronous_lines.@L: level/cpu meter push, enabled with 'LVLSUB <mode>'. Fields: @L <in_dB10> <out_dB10> <cpu_used>/<cpu_budget> <engine_used>/<limit> <lr> <gen> [<capture_in>]  (unverified order beyond the regex used)
asynchronous_lines.@K: knob / footswitch changes made on the pedal itself (parameter, on/off, amp-EQ, saved-slot reports)
other_unsolicited: CALIB ... (one line ~every 3 s while calibration runs)

conventions.banks: Block chain is two lists: P (before the amp/capture block) and Q (after it). Max 10 blocks per bank, 16 in total, 7 parameters per block, 3 parallel groups per bank.
conventions.block_instance_id: Each block instance has a numeric id (id=) assigned by the pedal when added. All edit commands address the instance id, NOT its position or its effect type id.
conventions.lanes: lane 0 = serial, 1 = parallel branch A, 2 = parallel branch B. A contiguous run of blocks with lane 1/2 forms one parallel group (numbered 0.. within its bank, in order).
conventions.amp_block: The amp is the NAM capture slot, not an FX type. It marks the P/Q boundary and is controlled with AMP / AMPX.
conventions.preset_slots: 32 presets, slot 0..31. Display convention: bank = floor(slot/4)+1, letter = A..D for slot%4.
conventions.number_formats: decimal integers (signed where noted); hex only for CRC32 (8 lowercase hex digits) and binary payload bytes (2 lowercase hex digits per byte, no separators); colours are 6 hex digits rrggbb.

PING.reply_example_shape: PONG tankg_fw M5.26 rel amx ble tankb v1 <build date>

parsing.firmware_number: token 'M<major>.<minor>' -> major*100+minor (used for feature gating: >=452 has EVT log, >=483 allows 190-char lines)
parsing.trailing_flag: ' safe' at end of the whole line = started in safe mode

initial_sync_sequence_used_by_host: BLE (only if flag ble; reply 'BLE ... mtu=N ...' bond info)
global settings reads (GEQ/HPF/SPILL/GLIDE/SPUR/LIM/FSA/FSPRESS/FSMODE/FSLED/LEDCFG/PCOLOR are read-back forms of the same commands)
then LVLSUB / LVL polling every 250 ms

FXT.purpose: Dump the effect-type catalog (ids, names, parameter ranges).
reply_lines: FXT <param_index> <param_name> <min>..<max> (<default>)      (one per parameter, follows its type line)
FXT os tiers=<off>,<normal>,<high> [cost=<a>,<b>,<c>]       (oversampling values of that type)

FXS.note: p= lists raw parameter values in parameter-index order for that block's type.

LVL.reply: LVL in=<dB10> out=<dB10> ci=<clips> co=<clips> fx=<used>/<budget> mem=<n> sk=<skips> m=<mode> g=<in_dB>/<out_dB> [ce=..] [a=<amp_on> e=<used>/<budget> am=<arena>] [b=<bpm10> s=<scene>] [c=<chain_generation> p=<preset>] [tu=<0|1>] [fm=<layout>,<live>,<bank>,<bypass>] [cin=<n> ctg=<n>] [stuck=<0|1>] [bat=...]
LVL.use: c= is a change counter: when it changes the host re-reads FXS. p= is the current preset (-1 none). s= current scene (-1 none).

LVLSUB.effect: Enable unsolicited '@L' meter lines (mode value not fully determined; host re-asks with 'LVLSUB' on connect and falls back to LVL polling if unsupported).

STW.note: Stereo-headphone width switch of the preset (firmware with stereo support only; others answer ERR STW).

PLIST.validity: Host re-issues up to 3 times if lines are missing/garbled (slot out of 0..31, out of order, name >23 chars, current slot absent from list).

PLOAD.reply: PLOAD ok ... missing=<blocks that did not fit> ... ms=<n> [capture_err='<text>']
PLOAD.after: host re-reads FXS, SNAPS, SNAPNAME, MODEL, STW, AMPEQ, MEM and LVL

PSAVE.effect: Writes the currently sounding chain (not scenes) + capture reference to flash slot; the pedal becomes 'in' that slot.

PNAME.effect: Rename in flash only; query form 'PNAME' (no args) answers a usage ERR on firmware that has it.

SNAPS.note: b = 1 if that scene is stored.

SNAP.effect: Switch to that scene (applies stored per-block on/off, parameter values, input/output gain, amp on, amp EQ). Prefix match must use 'SNAP ' with trailing space to avoid SNAPS/SNAPSAVE.

SNAPSAVE.effect: Store current state as that scene inside the current preset (flash write if preset>=0).

BPM.note: TAP tempo is computed on the host; query form 'BPM'.

GAIN.note: Part of the scene snapshot. Query form 'GAIN'.

TUNER.note: Query form 'TUNER'. ref_Hz is an integer (A4 reference, 440 by default; the UI allows 432..445). 'TUNER 0' leaves tuner mode. mute=1 silences the output while tuning.

reply_lines: TUNE <no note: reply without a note name when no pitch is detected>
TUNE.terminator: first token 'TUNE' (not to be confused with the 'TUNER' reply)
TUNE.note: Poll while tuner mode is on (the reference page polls about every 25 ms, one command in flight). <note> is a letter A..G with an optional '#', <octave> an integer (A4 = 440 Hz). 'TUNE off' means the pedal left tuner mode by itself (footswitch). level is the input level in dB x10 (-1400 or lower = silence). ons increments on each new note onset. DERIVED from the reference web page's parser, not verified against a pedal.

block_on_off.note: One FXE per block. The amp/capture block uses AMP instead.

amp_remove_or_add.note: 0 removes the capture block (its memory goes to effects); 1 re-adds it at the P/Q boundary.

change_effect_model_of_block.note: No in-place type change command exists. The host replaces a block by: FXR <id>  ->  FXA <bank> <position> <new_type_name>, then restores parameters (FXP), lane (FXL) and on/off (FXE) on the new instance id. On failure it re-adds the old type.

errors: ERR FXA out of memory: all 4 reverb2 states are in use
FXA.default_parameters: New block starts with the defaults from the FXT table.

FXM.effect: Move block (reorder / move across the amp).

FXL.effect: Set serial / branch A / branch B.
errors: ERR FXL too many parallel groups (max 3 per bank)

FXMIX.note: Query form 'FXMIX' lists all groups ending 'FXMIX end'.

set_parameter_value.value_rule: Integer in the parameter's [min,max] from the effect table; the pedal clamps and echoes the stored value. Units/encodings: see parameter_encodings. Sent live while a knob moves; no flash write until PSAVE/SNAPSAVE.
set_parameter_value.knobs_of_same_block_may_be_sent_back_to_: yes, one command at a time

oversampling.reply: FXOS ok id=<id> <type> os=<n> lat=<n> cost=<n> ticks=<n>
oversampling.note: Convenience for the os_n parameter of nonlinear blocks.

block_ir_selection.note: -1 = use the shared preset IR. Stored in the block's ir_slot parameter as slot+1 (0 = shared). Timeout 8000 ms.

amp_eq.reply: AMPEQ volume=<n> bass=<n> mid=<n> treble=<n> presence=<n> drive=<n>
query_forms: AMPEQ info (returns centre frequencies/limits on newer firmware)

GSAVE.effect: Persist global settings (below) to flash. Until then they are live but unsaved.

settings_commands_saved_by_GSAVE.LEDCFG: LEDCFG <key>=<value> keys: bright tuner tap meter hold anim idle

read_back_shapes.GEQ: 'GEQ' -> one line 'GEQ <b0> <b1> <b2> <b3> <b4>' (integer dB); 'GEQ <band> <dB>' sets one band
read_back_shapes.FSA: 'FSA' -> 12 lines 'FSA <fs> <gesture> <type> <a> <b> [id=<x>,<y>]' then 'FSA end'. Gestures: 0 tap, 1 hold, 2 double. Host sets with 'FSA <fs> <gesture> <type> <a> <b>'.
read_back_shapes.FSMODE: 'FSMODE' -> 'FSMODE layout=<factory|scenes|custom> mode=<preset|live> bank=<n> bypass=<0|1>'; 'FSMODE layout=<..>' sets. Send the FSA lines BEFORE the layout.
read_back_shapes.FSLED: 'FSLED' -> 4 lines 'FSLED <fs> <auto|custom> on=<rrggbb> off=<rrggbb>' then 'FSLED end'; set: 'FSLED <fs> auto' or 'FSLED <fs> <on rrggbb> <off rrggbb>'
read_back_shapes.LEDCFG: 'LEDCFG' -> 'LEDCFG bright=<0..100> tuner=<off|needle|strobe> tap=<0..2> meter=<off|edit|always> hold=<0|1> anim=<0|1> idle=<0|30|60|120>'

host_ui.note: Value ranges and presets the host UI offers. Ranges come from the reference page's controls; the firmware is the authority. The pedal has NO global volume / cab command and NO bypass for the global EQ (all bands at 0 dB is flat): the host emulates bypass by flattening the bands and remembering the values.

footswitch_quick_setups.label: Fábrica
footswitch_quick_setups.desc: Os footswitches funcionam como no firmware original da M-VAVE. Suas ações próprias ficam guardadas.

footswitch_quick_setups.label: Modo Cena
footswitch_quick_setups.desc: Footswitches 1–4 chamam as cenas 1–4 (segurar: ações extras).

footswitch_quick_setups.label: Modo Preset
footswitch_quick_setups.desc: 1–2 trocam o preset, 3 troca a cena e 4 é tap tempo.

footswitch_quick_setups.label: Stompbox
footswitch_quick_setups.desc: 1–3 ligam e desligam blocos da cadeia; 4 é tap tempo.

errors: ERR CLOAD empty or invalid slot

CREAD.reply_info: CREAD <slot> len=<n> crc=<hex8> id=<hex8> aux=0 fs=0 name='<name>'
CREAD.note: Read-back of a stored capture in 96-byte pieces (newer firmware).

CTRIM.note: With 'live' the trim is applied to the sounding capture only; with a slot number it is written to the slot header.

common.mechanism: Same text transport. Binary is hex-encoded (2 lowercase hex chars/byte), one chunk per command line, each acknowledged before the next is sent (stop-and-wait). Sequence: BEGIN -> N x chunk -> END(crc) -> optional SAVE to slot.
common.chunk_ack: OK <PREFIX> <byte_offset> <bytes_written>   (host checks the last number equals the chunk size and that the reply starts with 'OK <PREFIX> <offset> '; any ERR or mismatch aborts: 'transfer failed at byte <offset>')
common.chunk_size_bytes: floor((min(max_line_chars,199) - len(PREFIX) - 2 - len(str(total_length))) / 2). At max_line_chars=190 and PREFIX of 3 chars this is ~90 bytes per line; at 31 (old firmware) 10-11 bytes.

crc32.algorithm: CRC-32/ISO-HDLC (zlib): poly 0xEDB88320 reflected, init 0xFFFFFFFF, final XOR 0xFFFFFFFF
crc32.computed_over: the whole uploaded byte stream (for a capture that includes the blob's own trailing CRC field)

common.slot_addressing: The upload goes into a RAM staging buffer first (NOT a slot). The slot is chosen only by the final SAVE command (CSAVE / ISAVE). Without SAVE the item just plays (capture) / is used by the shared IR and is lost when another is loaded.
common.cleanup_on_failure: Release the staging buffer with 'LDBEGIN 0' (capture) or 'IRBEGIN 0 0 48' (IR; may answer ERR on older firmware). Re-enable audio with 'AUDIO A2L' if it was on.

capture_nam.source_file: .nam (NAM A2 'Lite' WaveNet). Must be converted on the host to the pedal's native 'A2L1' blob first (see a2l1_blob_format). A ready .a2l file is sent as is.

steps.note: Mute engine during upload (remember previous mode: 2 = capture engine running).

errors: ERR LDBEGIN length <n> (max 8192)  <- as mirrored by the page's built-in device simulator; real limit for A2L blobs not verified

steps.repeat: until all bytes sent, offsets strictly increasing, contiguous

steps.reply: LOAD rc=<code> name='<n>' layers=<n> channels=<n> audio=<mode> engine=<A2L|AMx> ms=<n>

rc_meaning.-2,-3,-21: engine for this format not in firmware (AMx)

steps.note: If the reply says audio<>2 and audio had been on, send 'AUDIO A2L' (timeout 12000 ms).
Only if the .nam metadata gave an input level in -20..40 dBu; stored into the slot header by the following CSAVE.
Name is ASCII only (non-ASCII replaced with '_').

capture_amx_passthrough.note: On firmware with flag 'amx': .am2/.am3/.am4 (+Data) files are sent unchanged using the same LDBEGIN/LDB/LDEND/CSAVE sequence (LDEND timeout 60 s). Magic 'AM2'|'AM3'|'AM4' at byte 0, byte 3 = 0, size <= 8192. A raw 6144-byte .am2 gets a 60-byte header prepended: 'AM2\0', name[13+], tuning bytes at 0x12..0x15 = 100,100,60,30, nine little-endian float32 at 0x18 = 100,-6,6,2000,-6,6,4000,-6,6.

body_after_offset_36: for each layer: u8 K ; u16 dilation ; i8 Fz ; i8 Fx3 ; i32 lmul ; i8 cF ; i16[C*C*K] convW ; i64[C] convB ; i8 mF ; i16[C] mixW ; i8 lF ; i16[C*C] l1W ; i64[C] l1B
head: i8 hF ; i16[C*head_K] hW ; i64 hB
u32 CRC32 of every preceding byte
a2l1_blob_format.constraints_checked_by_converter: |shift| <= 62 for every derived shift, conv shift 0..31 (otherwise firmware answers LOAD rc=-4)
a2l1_blob_format.scaling: Weights int16 with per-tensor fractional bits (F*); activations int32 with per-stage fractional bits; biases int64 in accumulator format; layer slope stored as round(slope * 2^24) in lmul.

a2l1_quantization.purpose: How the host derives every field of the A2L1 blob from a .nam file. Verified byte-for-byte against the reference browser converter on synthetic A2-Lite models (crates/pulsedeck-core/tests/reference.rs). Notation: F* = fractional bits; Q(v,F) = clamp(round_half_even(v * 2^F)); fbits(m,b) = b-1-(floor(log2 m)+1) (b-1 when m<=0).
source_model: Accept architecture WaveNet, or SlimmableContainer (use the submodel with the smallest max_value = Lite).

Requirements: exactly 1 layer array, channels=3, all activations LeakyReLU, layer1x1 active (groups 1), head1x1 inactive, no gating / secondary_activation / FiLM / condition_dsp / global head, head kernel 1..64, layer kernel 1..15, dilation 1..65535, sample_rate 48000, weights count = C + sum(C*C*K + 4C + C*C) + C*headK + 1(head bias) + 1(trailing head_scale slot).

Weights are read as float32 (then widened to float64). Flat order: rechannel[C]; per layer: conv[C*C*K] (index (co*C+ci)*K+k), conv_bias[C], input_mixer[C], layer1x1[C*C], layer1x1_bias[C]; head[C*headK] (index ci*headK+k), head_bias. head_scale comes from config.head_scale (default 1).

calibration.method: Float64 forward pass of the WaveNet over a calibration signal; record max|x| of: rechannel output (rech), z of each layer before activation = conv + bias + mixer (z[i]), residual x3 of each layer (x3[i]), head sum (head) and the final output including head_scale (out). Input is preceded by receptive_field-1 zeros.
calibration.signal: Built-in synthetic set measured segment by segment, maxima merged: 2 s log sweep 20 Hz..24 kHz (full scale), 2 s gaussian noise (sigma 0.5, clipped to +-1), three strummed guitar chords (E 2 s, A 1.5 s, D 1.5 s; Karplus-Strong, 12 ms string delay, peak 0.99, decay 0.9985). PRNG = mulberry32 seed 12345 + Box-Muller.
calibration.guard: Measured maxima are multiplied by 1.5 (+3.5 dB) when the built-in signal is used.

format_selection.Fh: min(fbits(head*2, 32), min_i(Fz_i) - 1)   (keeps the head-sum shift Fz-Fh >= 1 in every layer)

weight_quantisation.rule: Each tensor T gets F = min(fbits(max|T|, 16), Fcap); weights = Q(T, F) as int16.

Fcap.head: Fout - Fh + 31   (applied to head * head_scale; head_scale is folded into the head weights and bias)

weight_quantisation.model_name: metadata.name (or 'NAM'), UTF-8, truncated to 16 bytes at a character boundary

validation: All F values must fit int8.
|shift| <= 62 for: rF+Fin-Fx3_0; per layer cF+Fx3_(i-1)-Fz, mF+Fin-Fz, lF+Fz-Fx3, Fx3_(i-1)-Fx3, Fz-Fh.
Conv shift cF+Fx3_(i-1)-Fz in 0..31 for every layer; output shift hF+Fh-Fout in 0..31.
A blob failing these would be answered with LOAD rc=-4, so the host refuses to send it.

metadata_used_by_host.gear_type: metadata.gear_type classifies the capture for the UI. FULL_RIG: contains the cab (tokens cab / studio / rig / full, e.g. amp_cab, amp_pedal_cab, studio). AMP_ONLY: amp / preamp / head without cab (amp, preamp, pedal_amp). Anything else (pedal, missing) is 'other'.
metadata_used_by_host.input_level: metadata.input_level_dbu (fallback metadata.input_level); when in -20..40 dBu the host sends 'CTRIM live 0 <round(dBu*10)>' before CSAVE.

impulse_response_wav.source_file: .wav (any rate/channels the browser can decode; first channel used; resampled to 48 kHz by the browser)
host_preparation: Take the first N samples: N = 4076 for IR slots 0..6 and for an unslotted upload, 2028 for slot 7 (IRBEGIN accepts <= 4096).
Apply a raised-cosine fade-out over the last min(N/8, 256) samples.
Normalise to unit energy (divide by sqrt(sum x^2)); reject all-zero files.
Scale by the peak to full-scale int16: q[i] = round(x[i]/peak*32767).
gain_mdB = round(20000*log10(peak*32768/32767))  (integer milli-dB the pedal re-applies).
If the pedal answers an out-of-memory error, retry with N = 2048, then 1024.
impulse_response_wav.payload_encoding: signed int16 little-endian, mono, 48 kHz, 2 bytes per sample (byte stream = the Int16Array memory)

steps.note: Third argument is sample rate in kHz (24 or 48 accepted). 'IRBEGIN 0 0 48' releases the buffer.

steps.reply: IR ok <samples> samples gain <mdB> mdB fs <kHz>
steps.note: This loads it as the sounding (shared) IR.
Assign a stored IR to a specific 'ir' block.

effects.runtime_discovery: Authoritative list = reply of FXT (see commands.handshake_and_state_read.FXT); ids and ranges can change with firmware. This table is the reference catalog shipped in the control page (covers ids 1..39).
effects.not_an_fx_type: The amp/capture block is controlled with AMP/AMPX/AMPEQ and is absent from this table.
effects.category_note: Category is the pedal-side 'cat='. The editor additionally groups pitchpro and doubler as a 'pitch' family (field editor_family).

sync.note: index = value; 0 = use free time/rate parameter. Delay accepts 0..9, LFO effects 0..12.

os_n.note: FXT 'os tiers' line gives the values for off/normal/high.

parameter_encodings.ir.ir_slot: 0 = shared preset IR, n = stored IR slot n-1
parameter_encodings.basseq.geb7: 0 = Heart-Rock voicing, 1 = GEB-7 voicing (range allows up to 1023, only 0/1 used)

envfilter.filtro_modo.0..5: type*2 + direction: types LP,BP,HP (0-1 LP, 2-3 BP, 4-5 HP) with up/down sweep (exact order unverified)

parameter_encodings.rotary.inercia_pct: low 7 bits (0..127) = inertia percent; value>>7 = slow-rate in tenths of Hz (0 = default 0.8 Hz)
parameter_encodings.stereo_firmware_extra_parameters: Firmware built with stereo support may add parameters 'estereo' (0 mono /1 stereo; chorus, vibrato, delay use inverted 'mono' instead), 'ancho_pct' (width), 'modo_st' (doubler: 1 standard, 2 triple). They appear only in that firmware's FXT reply.
